title: GIOTTO simulator mutates LED state while refusing DIMLEDS
summary: GIOTTO simulator now mutates LED state only for accepted DIMLEDS requests. Configured-refusal and reconnect readback preserve the prior ON state; baseline confirmed by source, repaired behavior verified in scoped LED regression.
evidence: indigo_drivers/aux_giotto/giotto_simulator/giotto_simulator.c DIMLEDS branch at b6d3ee192; repair source bca08ca4e, settings_refused regression and LED task verification.
